description: Unit tests for SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier, testing notification behavior, observer management, config loading, invalidation, and refresh functionality.

classes.name: SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing SystemDnsConfigChangeNotifier behavior.

classes.name: TestObserver
classes.description: Observer implementation that records notifications and manages waiting for them.

methods.name: LoadConfig
methods.description: Loads a DNS config and waits for it to be received by the notifier.

methods.name: ReceiveNotification
methods.description: Test that verifies a single notification is received upon config change.

methods.name: ReceiveNotification_Multiple
methods.description: Test that verifies multiple notifications are received for multiple config changes.

methods.name: ReceiveInitialNotification
methods.description: Test that verifies a new observer receives initial config notification if config is already loaded.

methods.name: ReceiveInitialNotification_Multiple
methods.description: Test that verifies observer receives only the most recent config if multiple configs are loaded before adding observer.

methods.name: NotificationsStopAfterRemoval
methods.description: Test that verifies notifications stop after observer removal.

methods.name: UnchangedConfigs
methods.description: Test that duplicate configs do not trigger notifications.

methods.name: UnloadedConfig
methods.description: Test that verifies notification upon config invalidation.

methods.name: UnloadedConfig_Multiple
methods.description: Test that multiple invalidations result in a single notification.

methods.name: InitialConfigInvalid
methods.description: Test that verifies no notification occurs until a valid config is loaded after invalidation.

methods.name: RefreshConfig
methods.description: Test that verifies refresh triggers notification with the new config.
